prompts.prompt: Wide view inside Berwaldhallen's warm wood-paneled concert hall, a full symphony orchestra and large choir arranged on tiered platforms under amber stage lighting, conductor mid-gesture with audience silhouettes in the foreground.

Medium shot of a female cabaret singer in a black dress under a single warm spotlight at Göta Lejon, microphone raised toward her face, expression intense, soft red velvet curtain dimly lit behind her.

Environmental view through a Stockholm city bus window at dusk, a soprano in a flowing dress sings to seated passengers while suburban Huddinge streets glide past, streetlight mixing with the warm bus interior.
Close-up of a soprano's hands resting on the brass railing of an opera box at Folkoperan, pearl earrings and dark velvet costume softly lit, painted proscenium arch blurred in the background.
